motivation: Created by Dr. William H. Wolberg, W. Nick Street, and Olvi L. Mangasarian (1995) to predict malignancy directly from digitized images of fine needle aspirate (FNA) cell nuclei.
composition: 569 samples (212 malignant, 357 benign). 30 continuous real-valued features computing 10 nuclear characteristics (radius, texture, perimeter, area, smoothness, compactness, concavity, concave points, symmetry, fractal dimension) across mean, standard error, and 'worst'.
collection_process: Digitized micrographs of FNA glass slides from breast mass patients at the University of Wisconsin Hospitals, Madison. Cell boundaries determined via X-window program (Xcyt).
preprocessing_and_cleaning: Standardized feature scaling fitted strictly on training splits. No missing values in original WDBC.
uses_and_limitations: Benchmark dataset for algorithmic verification only. Extremely high signal-to-noise ratio untypical of routine screening. Completely lacks patient demographic variables.
maintenance_plan: Archival benchmark; preserved in Scikit-Learn standard distribution.
